title: UPSC CSE IAS IFS 2026 Pre Result: Out for Civil Services Exam #UPSCCSE2026 #IAS2026 #SarkariExam
intro: Union Public Service  Commission (UPSC ) has Officially Released Pre Result for The Post of Civil Service (IAS) and Indian Forest Service IFS Recruitment Examination 2026. Pre Exam Held On May 24, 2026 & Pre Result Released On June, 2026. All Interested Candidate Can Download Pre Result Now in The Given Link Below
importantDates: Payment Mode: Pay Exam Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking Fee Mode.
Must have been born not earlier than 2nd August, 1994 and not later than 1st August, 2005
For Age Relaxation, Read Official Notification
Indian Administrative Services (IAS) : Candidate Have Bachelor Degree in Any Stream in Any Recognized University in India

Indian Forest Services (IFS) : Candidate Have Bachelor Degree as one of Subject Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Science, Botany, Chemistry, Geology, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics and Zoology, Agriculture or Equivalent
Mode of Selection:  Selection on the Basis of Pre Exam, Mains Exam  & Interview
February 27, 2026: Last date for registration and fee payment.
To Be Notified: Mains and Interview dates.
Educational Qualification: Bachelor's Degree from recognized university.
Pay Scale: As per 7th CPC (Level 10-18: Rs. 56,100 - 2,50,000)
Mode of Selection: Prelims, Mains, Interview
Prestigious IAS/IFS: Top civil services career.
